title: Wound single-cell measurement construct validation
description: Software for testing whether a fibroblast-associated expression loading reflects cell-state abundance and supports patient-level healing inference in public wound single-cell data. The study includes technical controls, patient resampling, paired anatomy, representation comparisons and external tissue-context projections. It does not establish a clinically validated prognostic tool. This Zenodo deposit contains MIT software only. Manuscripts, artwork, source-study data, model weights and completed research outputs are excluded and retain their respective rights.
